usage.scope: all attempts in this review round

verdict.summary: The worktree is preserved and independent checks pass, but the reports contain unsupported workflow passes, incorrect motion analysis, and incomplete React-authoring evidence and acceptance gates.

findings.issue: The navigation matrix overstates coverage. find_panel_source actually runs in sample.tsx, Ctrl+P is never exercised from Live, and Ctrl+Shift+F is only exercised from Source. Dirty-buffer behavior, non-editor focus states, and case/regex/path behavior lack probes or concrete tooling limitations.
findings.expected: Correct the mislabeled evidence and provide an explicit shortcut/file/focus matrix containing actual outcomes or specific verification limitations.
findings.evidence: Probe lines 206–243 and 274–365; find-panel-source.png visibly shows sample.tsx; research report lines 150–161 claim Source/Live/TSX passes.

findings.issue: The React-authoring audit lists registered capabilities but never exercises creation, completion/imports, signature help, definition, diagnostics, or safe preview. Its root sample.tsx fixture bypasses the interactive project workbench and receives no language intelligence, so its typing measurements do not characterize the React authoring loop.
findings.expected: Audit an isolated interactives/<slug> project, distinguish plain TSX editing from project intelligence, and record current workflow findings or concrete tooling limitations without treating historic GOAL-25/27 verification as current proof.
findings.evidence: Report lines 104–128 and 372–379; probe lines 122–128 and 417–426; src/shared/interactive-authoring.ts:278; src/renderer/src/components/layout/MainEditor.tsx:339 and :357; src/renderer/src/editor/TextFileEditor.tsx:45.

findings.issue: The caret feasibility analysis incorrectly says this app uses the browser's native caret and needs a new drawn overlay. The app already installs drawSelection(), which replaces the native cursor with overlaid elements. The probe writes the incorrect architecture claim as a constant rather than measuring it.
findings.expected: Correct the architecture analysis and generated evidence; distinguish existing cursor drawing/blinking from missing caret gliding and reassess the proposal accordingly.

findings.issue: Required Zed input/rendering source research is absent. The report instead infers optional editor smoothing from reduce_motion, which does not establish that capability.
findings.expected: Inspect and cite upstream editor/input/rendering implementations with identifiable revisions where practical. Remove or qualify smoothing claims unless directly supported.
findings.evidence: Report lines 212–236 and 316–325 cite keymaps, settings and a performance blog, but no input/rendering implementation. The cited [Zed settings reference](https://zed.dev/docs/reference/all-settings#reduce-motion) describes suppression of nonessential UI motion such as spinners and pulsating labels.

findings.issue: The required task context is incorrectly reported missing: it exists at scripts/.zcode-dispatch/developer-dx-task.md. The implementation sequence also drops explicit acceptance gates for React authoring, typing responsiveness, and integrated dev/production and native-IME verification.
findings.expected: Read the existing context, correct both reports, and retain every required outcome in ranked stages with observable gates. Native IME may remain unverified in this stage, but needs a concrete subsequent verification design.
findings.evidence: Research lines 13–18 and 402–427; verification lines 119–120; scripts/.zcode-dispatch/developer-dx-task.md, sections 'Remaining outcomes' and 'Full desired outcome'.

findings.issue: The latency conclusion exceeds the measurement: next-rAF timing does not prove text presentation or rule out median input cost. The claim that every median fits a 60 Hz frame also conflicts with the reported 17.9 ms median. The fixture described as 800 lines is generated with roughly 1,600 lines.
findings.expected: Correct fixture dimensions and arithmetic, qualify the timing proxy, and avoid declaring the responsiveness problem resolved without an appropriate measurement and acceptance budget.

findings.issue: Profile isolation is asserted but not demonstrated by saved evidence. The helper attaches to any supplied CDP endpoint and persistently changes app settings before verifying profile identity. The ledger records only a placeholder launch command, and the results omit the actual profile.
findings.expected: Record the actual isolated launch/profile identity and command outcome, and verify that identity before settings or vault mutations. Correct the claim that writes occur only in the fixture and output directory.
findings.evidence: Probe lines 86 and 135–147; verification lines 39–45 and 112; dx-audit-results.json records the fixture vault but no profile identity; src/main/services/app-settings.ts:242 persists settings.

checks.name: Reports distinguish supported facts, measurements and proposals
checks.evidence: Both reports exist, but workflow labels, caret architecture and upstream smoothing claims conflict with inspected evidence.

checks.name: Relevant Zed settings remain redacted
checks.evidence: The report reproduces only buffer_font_size=15; independent allowlisted inspection of the named Zed settings file confirms that value.

checks.name: Navigation and search evidence matrix
checks.evidence: Probe/source comparison identifies missing focus/surface coverage and a TSX check mislabeled as Source.

checks.name: Whole-vault TSX search coverage trace
checks.evidence: src/main/services/vault-index-runtime.ts:113 rejects non-Markdown files; vault-service.ts:93 limits indexed extensions; generated evidence records the TSX-token miss.

checks.name: React-authoring and responsiveness findings and gates
checks.evidence: No interactive-project probe; recommended stages omit React-loop and input-performance acceptance gates.

checks.name: Native IME and historical benchmark qualifications
checks.evidence: Research lines 189–202 explicitly distinguish CDP composition from OS IME; production latency and historical metrics are qualified.

checks.name: Requirement retention and GOAL-27 decisions
checks.evidence: Monaco, formatter and multi-file-write restrictions are identified, but required task context and subsequent verification outcomes are omitted.

checks.name: Pre-existing worktree preservation
checks.evidence: Independent SHA-256 comparison found all 580 baseline files present and unchanged. review/round-0/changed-paths.json lists only authorized additions and no removals.

checks.name: Actual isolated profile execution
checks.evidence: Saved probe evidence lacks profile identity and an actual launch receipt; helper isolation depends on an unchecked caller precondition.

checks.name: Typecheck, lint and relevant existing tests
checks.evidence: Independent dispatcher verification.json and check-1/2/3 logs show exit 0: all typechecks, Biome checking 458 files, and 51 DX tests across four files.
